question: What is our escalation rate?
How long do tickets take to resolve?
raw_sql:
SELECT AVG(time_to_first_resolution) AS avg_resolution_time
FROM (
    SELECT 
        tickets.ticket_id,
        tickets.opened_at,
        MIN(event_at) AS time_to_first_resolution
    FROM 
        support.ticket_events AS event
    JOIN 
        marts.dim_tenant AS tenant
    ON 
        event.tenant_id = tenant.tenant_id
    JOIN 
        support.tickets AS tickets
    ON 
        event.ticket_id = tickets.ticket_id
    WHERE 
        event.actor_type = 'agent'
        AND event.event_type = 'resolved'
        AND tenant.tenant_name = 'primary'
        AND tickets.tenant_id NOT LIKE 'test-%'
    GROUP BY 
        tickets.ticket_id, tickets.opened_at
) AS resolved_events;

question: What is the average resolution time for billing?
raw_sql:
SELECT 
    AVG(time_to_final_resolution) AS avg_resolution_time
FROM (
    SELECT 
        fct_requests.request_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN fct_requests.call_index = 0 THEN fct_requests.latency_ms ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS time_to_final_resolution
    FROM 
        marts.fct_requests
    WHERE 
        fct_requests.tenant_id = 'billing'
        AND fct_requests.split = 'test'
        AND fct_requests.arm = 'primary'
    GROUP BY 
        fct_requests.request_id
) fct_requests
JOIN 
    marts.fct_outcomes fct_outcomes ON fct_requests.request_id = fct_outcomes.final_request_id
WHERE 
    fct_outcomes.tenant_id = 'billing'
    AND fct_outcomes.arm = 'primary'
    AND fct_outcomes.split = 'test';
sql: SELECT AVG(time_to_final_resolution) AS avg_resolution_time FROM (SELECT fct_requests.request_id, SUM(CASE WHEN fct_requests.call_index = 0 THEN fct_requests.latency_ms ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS time_to_final_resolution FROM marts.fct_requests WHERE fct_requests.tenant_id = 'billing' AND fct_requests.split = 'test' AND fct_requests.arm = 'primary' GROUP BY fct_requests.request_id) AS fct_requests JOIN marts.fct_outcomes AS fct_outcomes ON fct_requests.request_id = fct_outcomes.final_request_id WHERE fct_outcomes.tenant_id = 'billing' AND fct_outcomes.arm = 'primary' AND fct_outcomes.split = 'test' LIMIT 1000

question: Show me the cache results.
raw_sql:
SELECT 
    t.tenant_id,
    t.channel,
    t.priority,
    t.opened_at,
    t.status,
    t.ai_predicted_intent,
    t.final_intent,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f.cache_status = 'HIT') AS cache_hit_count
FROM 
    support.tickets t
JOIN 
    marts.fct_requests f ON f.request_id = t.decision_id
WHERE 
    t.tenant_id NOT LIKE 'test-%' -- [R-EXCLUDE-TEST-TENANTS]
    AND f.arm = 'primary' -- [R-PRIMARY-ARM]
    AND f.split = 'test' -- [R-HEADLINE-TEST-ONLY]
GROUP BY 
    t.tenant_id, t.channel, t.priority, t.opened_at, t.status, t.ai_predicted_intent, t.final_intent
ORDER BY 
    t.tenant_id, t.opened_at;
sql: SELECT t.tenant_id, t.channel, t.priority, t.opened_at, t.status, t.ai_predicted_intent, t.final_intent, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE f.cache_status = 'HIT') AS cache_hit_count FROM support.tickets AS t JOIN marts.fct_requests AS f ON f.request_id = t.decision_id WHERE t.tenant_id NOT LIKE 'test-%' /* [R-EXCLUDE-TEST-TENANTS] */ AND f.arm = 'primary' /* [R-PRIMARY-ARM] */ AND f.split = 'test' /* [R-HEADLINE-TEST-ONLY] */ GROUP BY t.tenant_id, t.channel, t.priority, t.opened_at, t.status, t.ai_predicted_intent, t.final_intent ORDER BY t.tenant_id, t.opened_at LIMIT 1000

question: How are the agents doing?
raw_sql:
SELECT 
    a.team AS team,
    COUNT(*) AS total_tickets,
    SUM(CASE WHEN te.event_type = 'resolved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS resolved_tickets,
    SUM(CASE WHEN te.event_type = 'escalated_to_human' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS escalated_tickets,
    SUM(CASE WHEN te.event_type = 'closed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS closed_tickets
FROM 
    support.agents a
JOIN 
    support.ticket_events te ON a.agent_id = te.agent_id
JOIN 
    support.tickets t ON te.ticket_id = t.ticket_id
WHERE 
    a.team NOT LIKE 'test-%'
GROUP BY 
    a.team
ORDER BY 
    a.team;
sql: SELECT a.team AS team, COUNT(*) AS total_tickets, SUM(CASE WHEN te.event_type = 'resolved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS resolved_tickets, SUM(CASE WHEN te.event_type = 'escalated_to_human' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS escalated_tickets, SUM(CASE WHEN te.event_type = 'closed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS closed_tickets FROM support.agents AS a JOIN support.ticket_events AS te ON a.agent_id = te.agent_id JOIN support.tickets AS t ON te.ticket_id = t.ticket_id WHERE a.team NOT LIKE 'test-%' GROUP BY a.team ORDER BY a.team LIMIT 1000

question: What is the cost per correct triage of each setup on the test split?

question: For decisions whose final call was a cache hit, which model produced them and how many were there?
raw_sql:
SELECT 
    m.requested_model
FROM (
    SELECT 
        fct_requests.requested_model,
        COUNT(*) AS cache_hit_count
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            fct_requests.requested_model,
            COUNT(*) AS n_calls,
            SUM(CASE WHEN fct_requests.cache_status = 'HIT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FILTER (WHERE fct_requests.cache_status = 'HIT') AS cache_hit_count
        FROM marts.fct_requests fct_requests
        WHERE 
            fct_requests.arm = 'primary'
            AND fct_requests.split = 'test'
            AND fct_requests.any_cache_hit = true
        GROUP BY 
            fct_requests.requested_model
    ) f
    GROUP BY 
        f.requested_model
) m
WHERE 
    m.cache_hit_count > 0;

question: Average cost per vllm call on the test split in the primary arm, per tenant display name.
raw_sql:
SELECT
    rt.display_name,
    AVG(mpcpo.total_cost_usd) AS avg_cost_per_call
FROM
    marts.fct_outcomes fco
JOIN
    marts.dim_tenant rt
ON
    fco.tenant_id = rt.tenant_id
JOIN
    marts.fct_requests fr
ON
    fco.decision_id = fr.decision_id

    marts.mart_cost_per_outcome mpcpo

    fco.run_id = mpcpo.run_id
    AND fco.tenant_id = mpcpo.tenant_id
    AND fco.feature = mpcpo.feature
    AND fco.setup = mpcpo.setup
    AND fco.prompt_version = mpcpo.prompt_version
    AND fco.split = mpcpo.split
    AND fco.arm = mpcpo.arm
WHERE
    fco.arm = 'primary'
    AND fco.split = 'test'
    AND fr.prompt_version = 'vllm'
GROUP BY
    rt.display_name;

question: How many distinct tickets did each agent help resolve?
raw_sql:
SELECT 
    a.agent_id,
    a.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.ticket_id) AS distinct_tickets_resolved
FROM 
    support.agents a
JOIN 
    support.tickets t ON a.agent_id = t.assigned_agent_id
JOIN 
    marts.fct_outcomes f ON t.ticket_id = f.ticket_id
WHERE 
    a.team NOT LIKE 'test-%' -- [R-EXCLUDE-TEST-TENANTS]
    AND f.arm = 'primary' -- [R-PRIMARY-ARM]
    AND f.is_correct -- [R-FAILED-IS-WRONG]
GROUP BY 
    a.agent_id, a.display_name
ORDER BY 
    distinct_tickets_resolved DESC;

question: What is the local model's accuracy for the support tenant?
raw_sql:
SELECT
    t.display_name AS tenant_name,
    f.prompt_version AS model_version,
    f.feature AS feature_name,
    f.setup AS setup_name,
    f.split AS split_name,
    f.arm AS arm_name,
    f.accuracy AS accuracy,
    f.cost_usd AS local_cost
FROM
    marts.fct_outcomes f
JOIN
    marts.dim_tenant t
ON
    f.tenant_id = t.tenant_id
WHERE
    t.owner_project = 'support'
    AND f.setup = 'B_local'
    AND f.arm = 'primary'
    AND f.split = 'test'
    AND f.arm = 'primary'  -- Apply R-PRIMARY-ARM rule
ORDER BY
    t.display_name,
    f.prompt_version,
    f.feature,
    f.setup,
    f.split,
    f.arm;
